relations.evidence: For more information about the Advanced Self-Recursion Parameter, see [Advanced DECREMENT Operation](eventing-advanced-keyspace-accessors.md#advanced-decrement-op).

notable_absence.finding: Pure code-sample page demonstrating couchbase.decrement(), the mirror image of advancedIncrementOp.md. Same reasoning as that page's record applies: couchbase.increment/decrement/touch are not enumerated in eventing:advanced-keyspace-accessor's registry description (get/upsert/replace/delete/insert only), so this concept was not forced onto this page. Note also: this page's own output log block ('success adv. increment: result') is copy-pasted verbatim from advancedIncrementOp.md rather than reading 'success adv. decrement: result' - the log text does not match the couchbase.decrement() call the code actually makes. Worth a docs-issue, but not evidenced as a graph relation since no predicate captures a copy-paste log mismatch.
